ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: In the figure is a D flip-flop with a clock input; the clock terminal labeled CP on the left is connected into the flip-flop, and inside the flip-flop are labeled 1D and C1. On the right there is the normal output terminal Q; on the lower right side there is also an output terminal with a small circle, indicating the inverted output. This inverted output with the small circle is fed back through an external wire to the D input terminal on the upper left side. Reasoning: The state transition rule of the D flip-flop is that the next state equals the signal applied to the D terminal at the current moment, namely Q^{n+1}=D. Since in the figure the D terminal receives the signal fed back from the inverted output, D=\overline{Q^n}. Therefore the state equation is Q^{n+1}=\overline{Q^n}.
